comments.mergedPostDetails: Before you were able to see if an Avatar was PC/Quest compatible from other people if you selected them, but now this is apparently not possible anywhere anymore. It would be nice if the little icons would be over the button like before.
comments.mergedPostTitle: [1137] [Feedback] Add back the platform icons to the "Clone Avatar" button

comments.mergedPostDetails:
The old clone button in the quick menu used to show what platforms an avatar was compatible with, but now neither the new quick menu's clone button nor the upgraded avatar details menu shows that information.
A workaround is to favorite an avatar and look at the compatibility icon on the avatar preview picture in your favorites list.

EDIT: merge with https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1137-platform-support-indicator-missing-from-the-clone-avatar-button pls
comments.mergedPostTitle: [1137] No way of knowing if another player's avatar is quest compatible

comments.value: yes please fix i have alot of quest friends and i use that alot.

details:
As the title says,
the Clone Avatar button in QM does no longer show if the other user's avatar is PC-only, Quest-only, or supports both.
While technically this is probably not a bug, it was very helpful with figuring out why you, and especially newer other users couldn't see something, so i'd like to see it back.
Similar to https://vrchat.canny.io/open-beta/p/1137-platform-support-indicator-missing-in-avatar-wing-menu .
